scrollable.item: Smoother drag handling: scrolling inside the body never closes the sheet by accident.

buttons.title: Built-in buttons or your own trigger
buttons.desc: Without as-child, Sheet.Trigger and Sheet.Close render a Button with label, variant, color, size, radius and icon. A Close without a label reads "Close" from the locale.
buttons.sheetDesc: Trigger and Close take the sheet color unless you set one on them.
buttons.customDesc: This sheet was opened by a PressButton passed through as-child.

controlled.title: Controlled and non-dismissable
controlled.desc: Bind v-model:open to open the sheet from anywhere. With :dismissable="false" the backdrop, Escape and dragging no longer close it.
controlled.sheetDesc: Only the button below closes this sheet.

props.color: Accent color shared by the trigger and close buttons. Inherits from ModoProvider.
props.height: Resting height of Sheet.Content: fit content, half the viewport or full height.
props.expandable: Lets the user drag or scroll the sheet up into the full-height detent.
props.dismissable: Enables backdrop click, Escape and drag-down to dismiss.
props.size: Panel padding density. Inherits from ModoProvider.
props.contentColor: Accent color for the close button. Inherits from Sheet, then ModoProvider.
props.closeLabel: Accessible label for the corner close button.
props.ariaLabel: Accessible name used when there is no Sheet.Title.
props.asChild: Binds the behavior to the slotted element instead of rendering a Button.
props.label: Button text when no slot content is given. Close falls back to the locale's "Close".
props.buttonTheme: Button color, size and radius. Color inherits from the sheet; size and radius from ModoProvider.

emits.updateOpen: Emitted when the open state changes (v-model:open).
emits.openChange: Emitted on every open or close.

slots.default: Compound children: Sheet.Trigger, Sheet.Content, Sheet.Header, Sheet.Title, Sheet.Description, Sheet.Body, Sheet.Footer and Sheet.Close.
slots.trigger: Button content, or the element to bind with as-child. Scoped: { open }.
slots.close: Button content, or the element to bind with as-child. Scoped: { close }.

types.title: Types
types.desc: TypeScript interfaces for Sheet, Sheet.Content and the Trigger and Close buttons.

a11y.kbOpen: Opens the sheet from the focused trigger
a11y.kbTab: Moves focus inside the sheet while it is open (focus trap)
a11y.kbEsc: Closes the topmost sheet when dismissable is true
a11y.ariaLabelledby: Linked automatically to Sheet.Title and Sheet.Description
a11y.ariaLabel: Fallback accessible name when there is no Sheet.Title (locale sheet.label)
a11y.focusTrap: Focus moves into the sheet when it opens and stays there
a11y.focusRestore: Focus returns to the trigger when the sheet finishes closing
a11y.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion the slide is skipped and the sheet appears in place

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.description: Modal dialog that grows out of the button that opened it, or settles in the center of the screen, and folds back into it on close. Width steps match Modal. Follows ModoProvider for color, size, radius and dark mode.

seo.metaTitle: Vue Dialog Component — Morphing Modal & Alert Dialog
seo.metaDescription: Free, open-source Vue 3 Dialog component: morphs out of its trigger, supports trigger or center placement, Modal width steps, alertdialog mode and pull-to-close.
seo.intro: mood-ui's Dialog is a morphing modal and alert dialog for Vue 3 and Nuxt. It measures the trigger before paint, animates position, radius and surface into the panel, and folds back into the trigger when it closes.

playground.title: Rename project
playground.desc: The button turns into this panel and folds back into it when you close it. You can also drag the panel down to close it.

widths.title: Centered placement and widths
widths.desc: placement="center" turns it into a classic modal over a dimmed backdrop. width uses the same steps as Modal: xsmall, small, medium, large, xlarge and full.
widths.dialogDesc: It still morphs from the button you clicked, then settles in the center of the viewport.

buttons.title: Built-in buttons or your own trigger
buttons.desc: Without as-child, Dialog.Trigger and Dialog.Close render a Button with label, variant, color, size, radius and icon. A Close without a label reads "Close" from the locale. With as-child, any element becomes the trigger.
buttons.dialogDesc: Trigger and Close take the dialog color unless you set one on them.
buttons.customDesc: This dialog was opened by a PressButton passed through as-child.

surface.title: Trigger surface and icon tile
surface.desc: surface="trigger" keeps the trigger's background, lightly tinted with the dialog color. Dialog.Icon follows the dialog color and accepts its own size and radius.
surface.dialogDesc: The panel keeps the look of the button that opened it, so the morph reads as one object.
surface.iconDesc: Large, fully rounded tile in the dialog's warning color.

alert.title: Alert dialog
alert.desc: alert switches to role="alertdialog", hides the corner close button and ignores outside clicks, so the user has to pick an action.
alert.dialogDesc: This cannot be undone. Outside clicks and the corner button are disabled in alert mode.

controlled.title: Controlled open state
controlled.desc: Bind v-model:open to open the dialog from anywhere. Without a Dialog.Title, ariaLabel gives the panel its accessible name.

props.color: Accent color shared by the trigger, close buttons and icon. Inherits from ModoProvider.
props.placement: Where the dialog settles: next to the trigger or in the center of the viewport.
props.side: Preferred vertical side relative to the trigger when placement is 'trigger'.
props.align: Horizontal alignment relative to the trigger when placement is 'trigger'.
props.surface: 'auto' uses the card surface; 'trigger' keeps the trigger's background, tinted with the color.
props.width: Panel width, same steps as Modal: 20rem, 24rem, 28rem, 42rem, 56rem or the full viewport.
props.size: Panel padding density. Inherits from ModoProvider.
props.contentColor: Accent color for the close button and icon. Inherits from Dialog, then ModoProvider.
props.alert: Uses role="alertdialog", hides the corner close button and disables outside dismissal by default.
props.dismissable: Allows outside click, Escape and drag-to-close.
props.closeLabel: Accessible label for the corner close button.
props.ariaLabel: Accessible name used when there is no Dialog.Title.
props.asChild: Binds the behavior to the slotted element instead of rendering a Button.
props.label: Button text when no slot content is given. Close falls back to the locale's "Close".
props.buttonTheme: Button color, size and radius. Color inherits from the dialog; size and radius from ModoProvider.
props.iconTheme: Dialog.Icon tile color, size (32/36/40/48px) and radius. Inherit from Dialog.Content, then ModoProvider.

emits.updateOpen: Emitted when the open state changes (v-model:open).
emits.openChange: Emitted on every open or close.

slots.default: Compound children: Dialog.Trigger, Dialog.Content, Dialog.Header, Dialog.Icon, Dialog.Title, Dialog.Description, Dialog.Body, Dialog.Footer and Dialog.Close.
slots.trigger: Button content, or the element to bind with as-child. Scoped: { open }.
slots.close: Button content, or the element to bind with as-child. Scoped: { close }.

types.title: Types
types.desc: TypeScript interfaces for Dialog, Dialog.Content, the Trigger and Close buttons, and Dialog.Icon.

a11y.kbOpen: Opens the dialog from the focused trigger
a11y.kbTab: Moves focus inside the dialog while it is open (focus trap)
a11y.kbEsc: Closes the topmost dialog when dismissable is true
a11y.ariaDialog: Renders role="dialog" (role="alertdialog" with alert) and aria-modal="true"
a11y.ariaLabelledby: Linked automatically to Dialog.Title and Dialog.Description
a11y.ariaLabel: Fallback accessible name when there is no Dialog.Title (locale dialog.label)
a11y.ariaTrigger: The built-in trigger announces that it opens a dialog and whether it is expanded
a11y.focusTrap: Focus moves into the panel when it opens and stays there
a11y.focusRestore: Focus returns to the trigger once the close morph finishes
a11y.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion the morph is skipped and the panel appears in place

liquidToast.title: LiquidToast
liquidToast.description: The title pill fuses with its panel on an inverted surface. Queued notifications slide forward, and promise updates settle in place. Filled, subtle and outline variants are also available.

seo.metaDescription: Free, open-source Vue 3 liquid toast: a pill and panel that melt into one shape, with a queue, promise and in-place updates, actions and swipe to dismiss.
seo.intro: mood-ui's LiquidToast is a notification stack for Vue 3 and Nuxt. Mount one LiquidToaster, then call liquidToast from anywhere: toasts queue up, update in place by id, follow a promise from loading to success or error, and can be swiped away.

demo.savedDesc: Your workspace is up to date.
demo.queuedDesc: Waiting its turn in the queue.

colors.title: Colors
colors.desc: info, success, warning and danger shortcuts set the color for you. The dot shows a glyph that matches the color.
colors.warningDesc: 92% of your space is in use.

action.title: Action and persistent toast
action.desc: action adds a button. onClick receives close(); the toast closes after the click unless keepOpen is true. duration: 0 keeps it on screen until dismissed.
action.toastDesc: It was moved to the archive.

promise.title: Promise
promise.desc: promise() shows a loading toast and turns it into success or error when the promise settles. It returns the original promise.

update.title: Update in place
update.desc: Give a toast a stable id and call update() to change its text, color or duration without stacking a new one.

persistent.title: Filled and pinned
persistent.desc: variant: 'filled' uses the solid color. With duration: 0 and pauseOnHover: false the toast stays until the user closes it or you call dismissAll().
persistent.toastDesc: The service will be read-only from 23:00 to 23:30.

props.placement: Where the stack sits in the viewport. A toast can override it with its own placement.
props.max: Toasts on stage per placement; the rest wait as previews behind the last one.
props.defaultDuration: Duration in ms for toasts that do not set one. 0 keeps them until dismissed.
props.defaultVariant: Variant for toasts that do not set one.
props.offset: Distance from the viewport edge in px.
props.size: Size for every toast; a toast's own size wins. Inherits from ModoProvider.
props.radius: Radius for every toast; a toast's own radius wins. Inherits from ModoProvider.
props.controller: Isolated store from createLiquidToast(). Defaults to the shared liquidToast.
props.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the notification region.

controller.title: Controller
controller.desc: liquidToast is a shared controller that only acts in the browser. createLiquidToast() returns an isolated one for a second app or per-request state in Nuxt; pass it to LiquidToaster through controller.

types.title: Types
types.desc: Options accepted by push(), info(), success(), warning(), danger() and update(), and the controller API.

a11y.kbTab: Reaches the toast's action and close buttons; focus never jumps to a toast on its own
a11y.kbActivate: Runs the focused action or closes the toast
a11y.ariaRegion: The stack is a labelled region (ariaLabel, locale liquidToast.region)
a11y.ariaPolite: Info and success toasts are announced politely
a11y.ariaAssertive: Warning and danger toasts are announced right away
a11y.ariaPeek: Queued previews are hidden from assistive technology and cannot be focused
a11y.focusNoSteal: Announcements come from two persistent live regions, so a toast is read once and never steals focus
a11y.focusPause: The timer pauses while the pointer or focus is on the toast, and while the window is hidden
a11y.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion the liquid morph and swipe animation are removed

morphTooltip.title: MorphTooltip
morphTooltip.description: A tooltip that grows from its trigger after 400 ms of hover or immediately on keyboard focus. Moving to a neighbour within 300 ms skips the delay.

seo.metaDescription: Free, open-source Vue 3 morphing tooltip: grows out of its trigger, flips to fit, supports hover, focus, click and manual modes, and opens neighbours instantly.
seo.intro: mood-ui's MorphTooltip is a compound tooltip for Vue 3 and Nuxt. The label grows out of the trigger, lands with an arrow, flips when there is no room, and shares a warm window so a row of icon buttons reads fast.

sides.title: Sides
sides.desc: side sets the preferred side. When there is no room the tooltip flips and stays inside the viewport.

rich.title: Title and description
rich.desc: MorphTooltip.Title and MorphTooltip.Description add structure. color="inverted" uses the page surface; maxWidth caps the width.
rich.heading: Version history
rich.body: Review and restore earlier versions of this document.

warm.title: Neighbouring triggers
warm.desc: Once one tooltip is open, the ones next to it open without delay. Without as-child, the trigger renders a Button and forwards variant, icon and aria-label.

click.title: Open on click
click.desc: trigger="click" toggles the tooltip on click. Escape or a click outside closes it.
click.label: What is this?
click.content: Opens on click and closes on the next click, Escape or an outside tap.

manual.title: Manual control
manual.desc: trigger="manual" ignores hover and focus; the tooltip only follows v-model:open.

props.open: Controlled visibility. Pair it with trigger="manual" to drive it only from outside.
props.trigger: What opens the tooltip: hover, focus, click, manual, or a list of them.
props.openDelay: Delay in ms before opening on hover. Skipped while a neighbouring tooltip just closed.
props.closeDelay: Delay in ms before closing after the pointer leaves.
props.disabled: The tooltip never opens while true.
props.asChild: Binds the behavior to the single slotted element instead of rendering a Button.
props.side: Preferred side; flips when it does not fit.
props.align: Alignment along the side. 'auto' centers it.
props.offset: Distance from the trigger in px.
props.arrow: Opt in to an arrow after the chip lands.
props.color: Tooltip color. 'default' follows ModoProvider; 'inverted' uses the page surface.
props.size: Text size and padding. Inherits from ModoProvider.

slots.default: Compound children: MorphTooltip.Trigger, MorphTooltip.Content, MorphTooltip.Title and MorphTooltip.Description.
slots.trigger: Button content, or the single element to bind with as-child.
slots.content: Tooltip content. Keep it non-interactive; use Popover for links or buttons.

types.title: Types
types.desc: TypeScript interfaces for MorphTooltip, MorphTooltip.Trigger and MorphTooltip.Content.

a11y.kbTab: Focusing the trigger with the keyboard shows the tooltip right away
a11y.ariaDescribedBy: The trigger points to the visible tooltip through aria-describedby
a11y.focusVisible: Only keyboard focus (:focus-visible) opens it; a mouse click on the trigger does not
a11y.focusNonInteractive: Content is not focusable. Wrap disabled controls in a span so the tooltip still gets pointer events
a11y.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion the morph and streak are removed
